Application Materials.content:
Please complete the application form accordingly and attach copies of the documents as instructed. Your application will only be processed when we have received all the documents and payment.
- An updated Resume
- Your official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- Certified True Copies of CFA / ACCA certificates (if any)
- 2 Personal Statements (approximately 500-600 words each) on the following topics:
1. Explain your career and personal aspirations, and your motivation for pursuing the MSc in Quantitative Finance (MQF) programme.
2. Discuss one of the following topics:
1. Describe your greatest weakness and how you have tried to overcome it.
2. Describe your outstanding talents, skills and inherent abilities that are not reflected in your academic qualifications and records.
- 2 Referee Reports - Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the SMU MQF. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees and collect your recommendation forms on your behalf once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format)
- Any other supporting documents

Interview Requirements.content: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview within two weeks of the online application.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Bachelor's Degree (in any field with some level of mathematical rigour)**.
- Applicants should have a **good undergraduate degree from a reputable institution (in any field with some level of mathematical rigour)**.
- Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; **work experience is not required**. While no work experience is required for the full-time track, any relevant experience might be helpful. Work experience is strongly preferred for the part-time track.
- Candidates should be passionate about quantitative and computational skills to tackle practical problems in pricing, hedging, risk management, algorithmic trading, portfolio management, and other cutting edge financial applications.
- SMU graduates with **cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with **cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for 5 years after graduation. Please note that meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Pre-requisites include **GMAT / GRE / SMU Admissions Test**.
- Application requirements include “A good GMAT ([try a GMAT mini quiz](https://www.mba.com/gmat-mini-quiz?utm_campaign=Global_All_Mini-Quiz_11Apr2016&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=smu)) / GRE ([try a GRE mini quiz](https://www.ets.org/gre/gre-mini-quiz.html)) / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT) score” ([SMUAT Factsheet](https://postgraduate.smu.edu.sg/acton/attachment/11522/f-4aba8d35-81c0-41d8-860f-8aa1c29d5d03/1/-/-/-/-/SMU%20Admissions%20Test%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf)).
- **SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better**, and graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with **cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a **GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test Score** for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission; candidates may still be advised to submit GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test scores to further strengthen their application.
- If you have not taken the SMU Admissions Test/GMAT/GRE, you may first submit your online application and arrange for the test to be taken as soon as possible.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- Local / SMU track: A valid TOEFL / IELTS score is required if the medium of instruction of your undergraduate studies was not English; TOEFL **>90** and IELTS **>6.5**.
- International track: A TOEFL / IELTS score of TOEFL **>90** and IELTS **>6.5** is required for all applicants choosing this track. The page also states for the International Option: IELTS score of **7.0 overall with 6.5 in Writing**.
- FAQ: The International Track has an additional mandatory IELTS requirement for all applicants, imposed by the UK government.

Program Overview.content:
The Master of Science in Quantitative Finance (MQF) curriculum is tailored to meet the needs of the financial industry in three key areas: pricing and hedging, risk analytics and management, and quantitative trading and investment.
The programme is available in full-time and part-time modes. The programme duration for both the SMU MQF Local track and International track is 12 months + internship. The Local track is also available in a part-time mode of study at 24 months. The same core modules apply for both tracks.
- **Local track**: Students take all courses at SMU in Singapore and obtain an SMU MQF Degree. This is the preferred path for those already working in Singapore or who are unable to spend four months in London on the international track.
- **International track**: Students take Term 1 and Term 3 courses at SMU in Singapore, and Term 2 courses at Bayes Business School in London, UK, and graduate with a Joint MQF degree from both institutions.
On top of being Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) and European Quality Improvement System (EQUIS) accredited, the Lee Kong Chian School of Business is highly ranked for its research productivity, teaching effectiveness, graduate employability and international reputation.
The SMU MSc in Quantitative Finance is designed to equip students with both an in-depth knowledge of quantitative finance and a business-oriented, entrepreneurial mindset. The curriculum bridges theory and practice, helping students build expertise and skillsets that can be immediately applied to solving real-world problems. The curriculum consists of nine core modules and four elective modules. Students may choose to specialise in one of the following elective tracks: Financial Data Science, Algorithmic Trading and Risk Analytics. The Open Module refers to an Internship OR MQF elective OR other modules offered by other Schools.
Students learn to trade real-time with live data and master trading algorithms and microstructure under the guidance of knowledgeable faculty with current and extensive quant trading experience. Students may specialise in Algorithmic Trading, Financial Data Science, Quantitative Trading or Risk Analytics.
Class profile, from Classes of 2018-2021 (Full-time & Part-time): gender ratio 13 : 7; average age 26; international students 73%; nationalities 8; average years of work experience 2.3.
Alumni outcomes and testimonials include Anirudh Somani, Head of Actuarial & Research at 360F, Class of 2020, and Tricia Goh, International Private Bank Graduate Analyst at Deutsche Bank, Class of 2021. Tricia Goh described the MQF programme as “a balanced marriage of mathematics, finance and programming” and noted opportunities to network with industry professionals through professors' networks and career talks organised by SMU Postgraduate Career Services.
Industries that MQF graduates work in, based on graduating students from 2020 and 2021: Audit / Accounting 4%; Commodities 5%; Consulting 8%; Financial Services 55%; Technology 19%.
The MQF programme equips finance and banking industry professionals and fresh graduates with current knowledge, skills, and industry best practices in risk management, algorithmic trading, portfolio optimisation, model validation, pricing and hedging across multiple asset classes and markets. Both MAF and MQF programmes are applicable to candidates planning to switch career from non-finance to the finance and banking industries.
The programme provides graduates a bridge to enter the finance and banking industries, especially those that require a high degree of computing and mathematical skills.
Students of the MQF programme are required to complete nine cores, four electives, a Postgraduate Professional Development course and one open module. The MQF is an 18-month programme, which can also be completed in 12 months, comprising two options: the local and international option. The local option is also available in a part-time mode of study at 24 months.
The programme is taught by well-qualified and experienced SMU and Bayes Business School professors as well as industry professionals.

Curriculum.content:
The programme duration for both the SMU MQF Local track and International track is **12 months + internship**. The Local track is also available in a part-time mode of study at **24 months**. The same core modules and programme fees apply for both tracks.
- **Local track:** You will take all courses at SMU (Singapore) and obtain an SMU MQF Degree.
- **International track:** You will take your Term 1 and Term 3 Courses at SMU (Singapore), and Term 2 Courses at Bayes Business School (London, UK), and graduate with a Joint MQF degree from both institutions.
| Option | Term 1 | Term 2 | Term 3 | Term 4 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Local Option, 12 Months + Internship | 4 Core Modules | 5 Core Modules | 4 Elective Modules | 1 Open Module* |
| International Option, 12 Months + Internship | 5 Core Modules | 4 Core Modules (Bayes) | 4 Elective Modules | 1 Open Module* |
*The Open Module refers to an Internship OR MQF elective OR other modules offered by other Schools.
The curriculum consists of **nine core modules and four elective modules**. Students may choose to specialise in one of the following elective tracks: Financial Data Science, Algorithmic Trading and Risk Analytics.
**9 Core Modules**
- Asset Pricing
- Derivatives
- Econometrics of Financial Market
- Fixed Income Securities
- Numerical Methods
- Programming and Computational Finance
- Quantitative Analysis of Financial Markets
- Risk Analysis
- Stochastic Modelling in Finance
**4 Elective Modules**
Students can opt to do any 4 elective modules from the list below or choose to specialise in a track by completing 4 elective modules offered in the same track. Modules offered are subject to change.
| Algorithmic Trading Track | Financial Data Science Track | Risk Analysis Track |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C++ for Financial Engineering; Portfolio Management; Market Microstructure & Algorithmic Trading; Quantitative Trading Strategies | C++ for Financial Engineering; Machine Learning & Financial Application; Financial Data Science; Quantitative Trading Strategies | Credit Risk Model; Commodities Risk Management; Machine Learning & Financial Application; Market Microstructure & Algorithmic Trading |
Four Core Modules (Term 1):
- **Asset Pricing**
- **Stochastic Modelling in Finance**
- **Quantitative Analysis of Financial Markets**
- **Programming and Computational Financial**
Five Core Modules (Term 2):
- **Derivatives**
- **Fixed Income Securities**
- **Risk Analysis**
- **Numerical Methods**
- **Econometrics of Financial Markets**
Four Elective Modules (Term 3): You have the option to specialise in any one of the following elective tracks.
**Financial Data Science**
1. Quantitative Trading Strategies
2. C++ for Financial Engineering
3. Financial Data Science
4. Machine Learning & Financial Application
**Algorithmic Trading**
1. Quantitative Trading Strategies
2. Portfolio Management
3. C++ for Financial Engineering
4. Market Microstructure & Algorithmic Trading
**Risk Analysis**
1. Credit Risk Models
2. Market Microstructure & Algorithmic Trading
3. Commodities Risk Management
4. Machine Learning & Financial Application
Students of the MQF programme are required to complete **nine cores, four electives, a Postgraduate Professional Development course and one open* module**. The MQF is an **18-month programme**, which can also be completed in **12 months**, comprising of two options: the local and international option. The local option is also availiable in a part-time mode of study at **24 months**.
Both tracks offer the same curriculum and list of modules, both core and elective. The key difference lies in the exposure, where students of the International track will spend **3 months in Bayes Business School in London completing 4 core modules**, and students of the Singapore track will complete their entire programme in SMU.

Financial Aid.content:
Academic Excellence | Global Awareness | Leadership* | Community Impact* | Impact on Asia* | Women in Business*
*Denotes scholarships that students can apply for upon admission into the programme.*
These Scholarships entail award amounts up to **30% of the tuition fee**, with no bonds attached.
- **Academic Excellence:** The SMU MQF will offer the Academic Excellence Award to high-quality candidates with exceptional academic performance. Awards are based on academic merit, final grades and GMAT score. Tier One: Awardees must have achieved a GMAT of 720 or above. Tier Two: Awardees must have achieved a GMAT of 700 or above.
- **Global Awareness:** SMU MQF Programme is committed to crafting a very diverse and global academic environment. The Global Awareness Award is given to individuals who will contribute to the class room diversity and enrich the learning experience of students by way of cultural, personal or professional backgrounds.
- **Leadership:** With a Leadership Award, the SMU MQF Programme recognises individuals with strong leadership potential who have exhibited outstanding leadership potential during their studies, community or organisation. Applicants must demonstrate strong leadership potential in personal and professional instances.
- **Community Impact:** The SMU MQF nurtures keen minds profoundly committed to leaving a positive impact on the community. The "Community Impact Award" recognises candidates who have contributed to society through outstanding community work and through their actions, have impacted members of the community/society in a positive manner.
- **Impact on Asia:** The SMU MQF is creating a significant impact in Singapore, extending now to Asia. Candidates should demonstrate achievements in their professional, social and personal life that have created an impact on Asia.
- **Women in Business:** With the Women in Business Award, the SMU MQF aims to recognise exceptional women who have demonstrated outstanding leadership capabilities or potential in their professional or personal endeavours. Applicants must have successfully received an admissions offer.
Lee Kuan Yew Scholarships: Established in honour of Singapore's former Prime Minister Mr Lee Kuan Yew, this scholarship recognises outstanding individuals with strong academic aptitude and the inclination to serve and contribute to the Singapore society at large. Eligibility criteria: 1. A Singapore citizen with at least a Second Upper Honours Degree or equivalent Degree 2. Excellent track record of leadership and service within or beyond applicant's profession. In addition to the one-off sum of S$10,000, private sector awardees will receive an annual allowance of S$50,000, while public sector awardees will receive S$10,000 if they are concurrently sponsored by their organisations.
SkillsFuture:
- SkillsFuture Funding for Singapore Citizens. [Click on this link for more details.](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/credit)
- The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme provides Singapore Citizens aged 40 years and above the opportunity to receive the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top up of $4,000. This credit is intended to offset out-of-pocket tuition fees, starting from Academic Year 2024/25 intake, commencing on or after 1 May 2024. Please visit [https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme](https://www.skillsfuture.gov.sg/level-up-programme) for further details.
- **SMU Alumni:** Graduates from SMU undergraduate or postgraduate programmes are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of **S$8,000** when applying to the MQF programme.
- **Singapore Local Autonomous University:** Graduates from NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, or SIT are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of **S$4,000** when applying to the MQF programme. Eligible candidates may receive exemptions for up to four credit units, with a discount of **$3,000** awarded for each credit unit exempted.
- **SG/PR:** Singaporean citizens and Permanent Residents are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$5,000**.
- **ASEAN Citizens:** ASEAN citizens are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$3,000**.
- **Corporate Partner:** Eligible company-sponsored candidates are eligible for a one-time discount of **S$6,000**. Contact the admissions team to discuss your eligibility.
The above discounts are applicable to students joining the programme from the January 2025 intake onwards. Each student is only eligible for one discount. Should a student qualify for more than one discount, only the higher discount will be applicable. The above tuition fee discount is deductable before Goods and Services Tax (GST).

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for more than one programme, you are only required to take the test once. Please contact your first-choice’s programme office to register for the test and update the other programme office upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: If I have to defer my studies due to unforeseen circumstances, what should I do? You will have to write in to seek permission from the Programme Director.
